programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u035/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row))\n    top_color = next(v for v in grid[0] if v != 0)\n    bottom_row = next(row for row in reversed(grid[divider + 1:]) if any(v != 0 for v in row))\n    shared = [c for c, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(grid[0], bottom_row)) if a == top_color and b == top_color]\n    for r in range(1, divider):\n        for c in shared:\n            if out[r][c] == 0:\n                out[r][c] = 4\n    return out\n'''
